en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 104 - A group of scholars informed me that Muhammad bin Yaqub narrates from Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim from his father from Ibn Umair from Saeed bin Ghazwan from Abu Basir from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s) that he said:
“After Husain (a.s), there will be nine Imams. The ninth of them is their Qaim.”
